title: Bitmine reaches 4.9% of Ethereum supply with 28,086 ETH purchase
dek: Bitmine acquired 28,086 ETH over one week, bringing its total treasury to 5,929,198 ETH (4.9% of Ethereum's 122 million ETH supply) valued at $14.79 billion. The company has bought ETH every week since June 30, 2025, and stakes approximately 85% of its holdings for yield.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: Bitmine's treasury reached 4.9% of all ETH supply with 5,929,198 ETH, 85% of which is staked, generating an annualized yield projection of $330 million at current rates.
bottom_line: The gap between Bitmine's 4.9% holding and its stated 5% target is now 0.1 percentage points, or roughly 122,000 ETH at current supply. The pace of weekly purchases will determine how quickly that threshold is crossed and whether Bitmine's buying discipline persists once the goal is reached.
body:
Bitmine acquired 28,086 ETH over one week, bringing its total treasury to 5,929,198 ETH representing 4.9% of Ethereum's 122 million ETH supply, according to The Defiant's reporting on September 8, 2026.
Using a Coinbase reference price of $2,495 per ETH as of September 7, The Defiant valued the position at $14.79 billion. Bitmine's aggregate holdings, which included 211 BTC, $593 million in cash and marketable securities, and stakes valued at $180 million in Beast Industries and $91 million in Eightco Holdings, totaled $15.7 billion as of September 7, up only $100 million from the prior week's $15.6 billion figure.
The 28,086 ETH purchase was smaller than the 53,501 ETH acquired in the preceding week, continuing a pattern of weekly accumulation since Bitmine's treasury strategy began on June 30, 2025. In July, the company held 5,742,237 ETH, then equal to about 4.8% of circulating supply. The company has increased its position to approach its stated goal of 5% of total Ethereum supply.
Approximately 85% of Bitmine's ETH holdings, or 5,067,309 ETH, was staked as of September 7.  Chairman Tom Lee stated that Bitmine has continued adding ETH.
